# Fuel Cells (FuelCell_PEM, FuelCell_SOFC)

## FuelCell_PEM

> **Class**: `FuelCell_PEM` | **Module**: `energysim.models.hydrogen` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

### Overview

Rapid-dispatch PEM Fuel Cell generator (constant electrical efficiency).

Fuel (H2, LHV) = electricity + waste heat; ``Q_waste_MW`` is all non-electric fuel power.
Output power ramps toward the command at ``ramp_rate_mw_min``. When idle (zero power)
no fuel is consumed and no heat is produced. A step with ``dt == 0`` leaves the power
state unchanged.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'PEM_FuelCell'` | - | Unique component name identifier |
| `p_nominal_mw` | `float` | `1.0` | MW | - |
| `electrical_efficiency` | `float` | `0.5` | - | - |
| `ramp_rate_mw_min` | `float` | `2.0` | MW/min | - |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

### Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_cmd` | MW | Active power dispatch setpoint |

### Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_actual` | MW | Net active power delivered to the electrical bus |
| `m_dot_H2_kg_hr` | kg/h | - |
| `Q_waste_MW` | MW | - |

### Validity and notes

Validity: constant electrical efficiency independent of load, power between 0 and p_nominal_mw,
ramp limited to ramp_rate_mw_min; no degradation or stack-temperature model.

### Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import FuelCell_PEM

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('fuelcell_pem', model=FuelCell_PEM(), outputs=['P_actual', 'm_dot_H2_kg_hr', 'Q_waste_MW'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['fuelcell_pem'].tail(2))
```

## FuelCell_SOFC

> **Class**: `FuelCell_SOFC` | **Module**: `energysim.models.hydrogen` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

### Overview

Solid Oxide Fuel Cell (SOFC) for high-efficiency baseload and high-grade CHP heat.

Constant efficiencies (no load dependence, no ramp limit). Fuel LHV power splits into
electricity (``electrical_efficiency``), recovered CHP heat (``thermal_efficiency``)
and unrecovered losses ``Q_loss_MW``; the sum of the two efficiencies must not
exceed 1. Idle: no fuel, no heat. Stateless: ``dt`` has no effect.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'SOFC_FuelCell'` | - | Unique component name identifier |
| `p_nominal_mw` | `float` | `1.0` | MW | - |
| `electrical_efficiency` | `float` | `0.6` | - | - |
| `thermal_efficiency` | `float` | `0.25` | - | - |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

### Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_cmd` | MW | Active power dispatch setpoint |

### Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_actual` | MW | Net active power delivered to the electrical bus |
| `m_dot_H2_kg_hr` | kg/h | - |
| `Q_chp_MW` | MW | - |
| `Q_loss_MW` | MW | - |

### Validity and notes

Validity: constant efficiencies independent of load, power between 0 and p_nominal_mw; no ramp
limit and no thermal-cycling or start-up model.

### Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import FuelCell_SOFC

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('fuelcell_sofc', model=FuelCell_SOFC(), outputs=['P_actual', 'm_dot_H2_kg_hr', 'Q_chp_MW'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['fuelcell_sofc'].tail(2))
```
